ClientResponses.Response:
Hello! Thank you for leaving us a review. We would be happy to address your concerns. The Flavorizer bars can develop surface corrosion due to their exposure to high heat and food drippings but they don’t need to be replaced unless they have holes or cracks in them. If they do develop holes, a replacement set #7635 can be purchased through our website.
Concerning the ignition, we would suggest replacing the battery, located in the module. If the issue remains, and if the wires are securely connected, a replacement igniter #7642 is available through Weber.com as well.
In regard to the uneven heat issue you have been experiencing, please make sure to brush the burner tubes so that the ports are fully open. If that does not help, please contact our team at support@weberstephen.com, and they will be happy to help and ensure your grill operates properly. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I have had our Spirit (two burner tube) grill for less than three years.  The triangular "flavorizors" have completely rusted through. Almost $500 down the drain.  Exercise caution when buying this grill or get comfortable replacing it within 3 years.

Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.
